KOTA KINABALU, 13 Oktober 2026 – Kerajaan Negeri Sabah mengarahkan semua sekolah di kawasan yang mencatatkan bacaan Indeks Pencemaran Udara (IPU) melebihi 150 selama tiga hari berturut-turut supaya ditutup sementara waktu.

Setiausaha Kerajaan Negeri Sabah, YB Datuk Zainudin bin Aman, yang juga Pengerusi Jawatankuasa Pengurusan Bencana Negeri, berkata langkah tersebut bertujuan melindungi murid dan guru daripada kesan buruk jerebu terhadap kesihatan.

Arahan itu turut selaras dengan arahan Kementerian Pendidikan susulan titah nasihat Yang di-Pertuan Agong, Sultan Ibrahim.

Setakat ini, semua sekolah di Tawau diarahkan ditutup mulai Rabu, 14 Oktober 2026, berikutan keadaan jerebu yang semakin buruk.

Orang ramai, khususnya ibu bapa dan penjaga, disaran mengikuti pengumuman rasmi pihak berkuasa dari semasa ke semasa bagi mendapatkan maklumat terkini berkaitan situasi jerebu dan operasi sekolah.

Albert Einstein – Proving Everyone Wrong 🧠 

This image highlights the early struggles of Albert Einstein, a name we now associate with pure genius, but his journey wasn’t smooth at all. 

Traditional schooling didn’t suit him. Even though he excelled in math and physics, he constantly clashed with teachers and was moved from school to school. Some even told him he would “never get anywhere.”

But Einstein didn’t let labels define him. 🚀

Instead, he followed his curiosity and passion. Over time, he became the most influential physicist of the 20th century, reshaping science and the way we understand the universe itself. Today, the word “genius” is practically synonymous with his name.
